answer: Every applicant faces the same trial, Tin packer iron warrant soldered into the painting shed, and every verdict reads the same way: each iron is a tin count weighed beside the maker's mark. No single shop can bless a forgery: the proof must survive three keepers who never meet. Time keeps the pigment, the ledger keeps the anchor, the toy shop keeps the mirror; the farm keeps nothing but its printer. One agent spends 26 minutes and is done; the farm spends 13494 minutes and ends with nothing to sell. Get caught once and the whole shelf burns: 519 masks, 63837 POA, gone on one grade.
